papers.title: In-Layer Laser Remelting Effects on Dry Sliding Tribology of Additive Manufactured Ti-6Al-4V ELI Using GLM–RSM Statistical Method
papers.abstract: Ti-6Al-4V ELI (Grade 23) fabricated by Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF) exhibits well-known susceptibility to adhesive wear and tribo-oxidation under dry sliding, yet the tribological consequences of in-process laser remelting remain poorly characterized. This study investigates the influence of an in-layer laser scan strategy (single-scan and double-scan), normal forces in the 5–15 N range, and a sliding speed of 0.10–0.20 m·s−1 on the dry sliding tribological response of additive manufactured Ti-6Al-4V ELI. A full factorial experimental design was carried out and the most significant factors and their contributions to the coefficient of friction, specific wear rate, and contact temperature were identified by a statistical method using a general linear model (GLM). The optimal parameters for both of the scan strategies were predicted using a response surface methodology (RSM). Furthermore, to assess the effect of the laser scan strategy and the in-layer remelting on the local mechanical properties, a microscale and nanoscale indentation was carried out. The results show that the normal load was the dominant factor with a contribution of 89.3% for the coefficient of friction, 54% for the specific wear rate, and 40.5% for the temperature. A significant load–scan strategy interaction that governed the wear behavior was detected. The double-scan strategy exhibited higher wear at 5 N but lower wear at 15 N than the single-scan, a counter-intuitive reversal attributed to the load-threshold tribolayer stabilization promoted by the remelting-induced near-surface microstructural modification. The novelty of this study was the setup of a robust GLM–RSM framework for predictive modeling and optimization of additively manufactured surfaces under tribological loading.

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇论文研究LPBF Ti-6Al-4V ELI的干滑动摩擦学性能，而非力学或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on tribological (wear) behavior rather than mechanical strength or fatigue performance of Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究LPBF Ti-6Al-4V ELI在干滑动下的摩擦磨损行为及层内激光重熔的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用全因子实验设计，结合GLM-RSM统计方法分析扫描策略和载荷对摩擦系数、磨损率和温度的影响。
summary_zh.result: 法向载荷是主要影响因素，双扫描策略在低载荷下磨损更高，高载荷下磨损更低。
summary_zh.validation: 通过宏观干滑动磨损试验和微纳压痕验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the dry sliding tribological response of LPBF Ti-6Al-4V ELI and the effect of in-layer laser remelting.
summary_en.method: A full factorial design with GLM-RSM statistical analysis was used to evaluate the influence of scan strategy and normal load on coefficient of friction, specific wear rate, and contact temperature.
summary_en.result: Normal load was the dominant factor; the double-scan strategy showed higher wear at low load but lower wear at high load due to tribolayer stabilization.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation via dry sliding wear tests and micro/nano-indentation.

papers.title: Observing dwell fatigue stress redistribution in Ti-6Al-4V grain neighborhoods using high energy X-rays
papers.first_author_affiliation: Materials Science and Engineering, The Pennsylvania State University, University Park, PA 16802, United States of America

corresponding_authors.name: Darren C. Pagan
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Materials Science and Engineering, The Pennsylvania State University, University Park, PA 16802, United States of America

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究Ti-6Al-4V的保载疲劳应力再分布，与方向要求高度吻合。
llm.why_not_core: No explicit tensile or S-N data; focus is on stress redistribution at grain scale rather than bulk mechanical properties or S-N curves.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究保载疲劳下Ti-6Al-4V晶粒尺度的应力分布演变。
summary_zh.method: 使用高能X射线衍射原位观测保载疲劳过程中的应力再分布。
summary_zh.result: 观察到晶界处应力集中导致早期裂纹萌生。
summary_zh.validation: 通过同步辐射X射线衍射实验验证晶尺度应力重分布。

summary_en.motivation: To understand the stress redistribution at grain neighborhood scale during dwell fatigue in Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: High-energy X-ray diffraction is used to in situ observe stress redistribution during dwell fatigue loading.
summary_en.result: Stress concentrations at grain boundaries are observed, leading to early crack initiation.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation via synchrotron X-ray diffraction measurements on Ti-6Al-4V specimens under dwell fatigue.
